theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R₁ R₂ : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R₁.Represents T → R₂.Represents T → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R₁.carrier ∪ R₂.carrier)), R₁.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₁.mult y : ℝ) • R₁.orient y) x = R₂.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₂.mult y : ℝ) • R₂.orient y) x
